CustomField.label: Tage jetzige Stage
CustomField.description: SCRUM-477: Whole days the open Opportunity has sat in its current Stage. Anchor is LastStageChangeDate (the real stage history, never ModifiedDate), so a stage change - forward or backward - restarts the count at 0. Records whose stage never changed after creation fall back to CreatedDate. Closed Won / Closed Lost return NULL, so a finished deal can never reach the stuck list. Formelfeld: systemberechnet, nobody maintains it by hand.
CustomField.formula: IF(OR(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost")), NULL, TODAY() - DATEVALUE(IF(ISBLANK(LastStageChangeDate), CreatedDate, LastStageChangeDate)))
